dialog.speaker: mom
dialog.tr: Bu ne? Koltuk mu? Nereye koyacağız? Salon dolu, odan dolu, balkon kışın soğuk.
dialog.en: What's this? An armchair? Where's it going? Living room's full, your room's full, the balcony gets cold.

dialog.speaker: mom
dialog.tr: Benim koltuğu kaldırmayız. O koltuk bu evde senden eski.
dialog.en: We're not moving my chair. That chair has been in this house longer than you.

oda.tr: Koltuk odaya girdi, yatağa artık yan yan geçiyorsun. Annen her gelişinde koltuğa oturup "rahatmış" diyor.
oda.en: The chair fits in your room. You now reach your bed sideways. Every time Mom comes in, she sits in it and says, "Comfy."

coach.tr: Kendine koltuk aldın. Annen test sürüşünde.
coach.en: You bought yourself a chair. Mom is test-driving it.

yer.tr: Annenin koltuğunu odana, yenisini salona koydun. Annen bir hafta salonda ayakta televizyon izledi.
yer.en: You moved Mom's chair to your room and put the new one in the living room. For a week, Mom watched TV standing up.

coach.en: The new chair is in the living room. Empty.

iade.tr: Koltuğu iade ettin. Akşam annen "aslında güzel koltuktu" dedi ve kendi koltuğunu biraz kenara çekti.
iade.en: You returned it. That evening Mom said, "It was a nice chair, actually," and nudged her own chair over a few inches.

coach.en: Space opened up. The chair was already gone.

wager.reason: check yok ya da düşük gerilim

intent.setup: kendi paranla aldığın büyük koltuğun annenin evine sığmaması
intent.punch: o koltuk bu evde senden eski
